dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: A same-day single-player request converted with a nearby alternative
highlights.summary: The caller wanted to play 18 holes at 1:15 PM that afternoon. When that time was unavailable, SpeakSport immediately offered the earliest viable alternative and completed the reservation for 1:30 PM.
highlights.quote: “I don’t have 1:15 PM available. I do have 1:30 PM available for you.” The caller accepted, and SpeakSport confirmed the same-day booking.

highlights.title: A payment question was answered without interrupting the booking
highlights.summary: A caller requested a two-player, nine-hole evening tee time and asked whether payment could be made on arrival. SpeakSport answered the question, confirmed the required details and completed the 6:50 PM reservation.
highlights.quote: “Absolutely. You can pay when you arrive.” SpeakSport then confirmed the booking and reminded the caller that carts were included in the green fee.

highlights.title: Detailed driving-range guidance was handled in under a minute
highlights.summary: SpeakSport answered a routine operational question with the regular range hours, the Wednesday maintenance opening time and the course’s grass-versus-mat schedule—without requiring a staff transfer.
highlights.quote: “The driving range is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Since today is Wednesday, it opens late at 10:00 AM for maintenance.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Booking windows, customer context and other applicable booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Timber Trace to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, preferred playing times and caller outcomes.
